note: Well-treed sites in a long string along the east shore of Lower Kananaskis Lake in Peter Lougheed Provincial Park; the sites on the lake side of the road sit at the top of the beach. Hand launch for canoes; a reservoir, so the water can be drawn far down. Run by Cedar & Spruce Campgrounds (on-site manager; Visa and MasterCard). Firewood sold by the manager or at the Boulton Creek store. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Alberta Parks page (updated Sep 25, 2026) and shop: unserviced C$31, Conservation Pass, mix of reservable (41) and FCFS (5) sites; corrected count 48 -> 46 (table and shop; the intro still says 48), max_rig_ft 27 -> 40 (shop; six sites under 23 ft), pull-throughs yes, vault toilets, hand-pump water not potable; season May 14 - Oct 12 (was approximate May 15 - Oct 15). Lakefront kept (18 shop 'Near Water' sites at the top of the beach). Phone 1-866-686-0339.

ADVISORIES (not the campground): a grizzly closure of Indefatigable Bowl (Nov 7, 2026), a pathway construction closure near William Watson Lodge (Oct 13, 2026), a paving refurbishment in late October/early November naming North Interlakes Day Use (Oct 24, 29) and other roads - none closes Interlakes Campground; no status.

WATERFRONT (stored lakefront - keep): the shop tags 18 sites 'Near Water' (10, 12, 17, 19, 23, 24, 25, 30, 32, 34, 35, 37, 38, 39, 41, 43, 45, 47). On imagery the campground road runs ~25-50 m behind the top of the beach, and the lake-side spurs end at the treeline edge with an open drawdown beach (sand/gravel, 60-100 m wide at the imagery's low water) to the water; the high-water line is the beach top, so those pads are within the open-apron bound. Recommend lakefront kept, ideally with a caveat that it is the lake-side sites (the shop's Near Water list). Site 19 is both Near Water and under 23 ft.

PIN (50.63021,-115.13772): at the campground's entrance off Kananaskis Lakes Trail, the north end of a ~1 km string of sites. The page's directions point 50.627243,-115.130924 sits on the campground road mid-string among the sites. Recommend moving to 50.62724,-115.13092 (~580 m SE).
